this just leaves '$bgp_ip' blank

Sorry, I can't reproduce this, your code actually works for me. Perhaps you just made a typo? Always [id://111088]! However, at the moment the code is doing the same as [tybalt89]'s XOR solution (Update: at least on your sample input that is) - if you want the logic to be the way you describe (.5 becomes .6 and vice versa), you need to reverse the +/- operations. On the other hand, [tybalt89] made a good point [id://1206354|here] - are you sure about the logic you described?
